QuestInfo.name: Can You Resist?
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra wants to check your self-control before the Legends Awards start.
QuestInfo.1: Keep the Golden Statue that you received from Cassandra for 30 minutes, and then return it to her.
QuestInfo.2: The whole thing was kind of silly, but you passed her test.

0.0: Hello! I bet you're looking forward to the upcoming Legends Awards, right? Well, we want to make sure that everyone who participates is, y'know, a good person. So, I've got a little test you can take, to see how much self-control you have! Ready to give it a try?

yes.0:
Great! The test is really simple. After all, I just want to see if you can resist the temptation to be greedy. 

I'm going to give you this lovely Golden Statue. All you have to do is hold it for 30 minutes and give it back. If you can keep yourself from running away with it or selling it, you pass the test. Do you think you can do that? 

Oh, and don't even think about logging out during the test. The Golden Statue will return to me automatically if you do that, and the test won't count.

Okay, here's the statue. Good luck!

no.0: Really? Is that because you think you'll fail? Hmmm?

1.0: Has it been 30 minutes already? That felt fast. So...are you going to give the Golden Statue back? I know you're hesitant...it IS such a beautiful and desirable statue. But, you have to return it now. Can you do it?

yes.0:
Wow, I'm impressed! You were able to overcome your powerful desires to run off with the statue, I guess. I don't think I could have done that... But never mind about that. You did great, and your amazing self-control deserves a reward! Here, this is for you.

You're welcome to challenge yourself again anytime. Just let me know! Me and my statue will be waiting...
